item.title: Flytipping on the floor bin men did not pick the bins that have general waste on mixed recycled bin covers, 6th September
item.description:
I have reported this several times, thanks for clearing some of them but the residents keep putting bin bags on the floor and bin men refused to pick them. Please see attached pictures, they are by the left on entering Owen close. This has to be investigated by the council. I am tired of sending messages all the time. I purposely left 2 notices there to remind everyone to put bin bags into the bin but they don’t listen. Foxes are around to liter the whole place. The bin men came today they did not pick the ones with general waste put in the blue top. It is becoming frustrating.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Owen Close, Thamesmead
